2025-s-0172.summary: In January 2023, Yevgeny Prigozhin suddenly launched a public vendetta against Russia’s Ministry of Defense which concluded with the assassination of Prigozhin, disguised as an airplane crash in Russia in August 2023. For months, it remained unclear what its leader’s death would mean for the Wagner Group, a private military company with GRU connections in Moscow and private business interests in Africa. After an analysis of Wagner Group aircraft activity throughout the continent, The Insider can report that the private military company’s flights to key destinations including the Central African Republic, Libya, and Mali remain active.
2025-s-0172.impact: Some of the aircraft mentioned in the investigation were already under scrutiny by UN Expert Groups (on CAR, Mali, and Libya), and some of their operators had been sanctioned under UN resolutions — though unsuccessfully, as the aircraft changed ownership. After The Insider investigation was published, the Russian company Abakan Air — one of the key transport providers for Wagner and Russian Ministry of Defence mercenary groups in Africa — along with its parent company Avializing Invest, which had not previously been the focus of any organization’s attention, were sanctioned by OFAC (https://ofac.treasury.gov/recent-actions/20240612). This designation makes the company less appealing for others to collaborate with.
2025-s-0172.tools: Scraping, Google Sheets, Python, leaflet + folium, api
2025-s-0172.summaryJa: 2023年1月,エヴゲニー・プリゴジンは突然ロシア国防省に対して公的な復讐を始めました.これは2023年8月にロシアで飛行機事故を犯したプリゴジンの暗殺で終わった.数ヶ月間,そのリーダーの死はモスクワでGRUの接続とアフリカでプライベートビジネス利益を持つ民間軍事会社であるワグナー・グループにとって何を意味するのかは不明でした. ヴァグナーグループ航空活動の分析の後,The Insiderは,民間軍事会社の中央アフリカ共和国,リビア,マリを含む重要な目的地に飛行が活発であることを報告することができます.
2025-s-0172.impactJa: 調査で言及された航空機のいくつかは既に国連専門家グループ (CAR,Mali, and Libya) によって監視されている.そしてそのオペレーターの一部は国連決議の下で制裁を受けたが,航空機の所有権を変更したため失敗した. The Insider調査が公表された後,ロシアの会社Abakan Airは,以前はどの組織でも注目されていないAvializing Investの母会社と共に,OFAC (https://ofac.treasury.gov/recent-actions/20240612) によって制裁を受けた.この指定により,会社には他の協力者が少ない.

2025-s-0173.summary: This story provides an in-depth look into the harrowing conditions faced by medical professionals in Gaza during ongoing Israeli assaults. The highly human, data-rich feature highlights the immense challenges doctors encounter, including making split-second decisions on patient care amidst resource shortages and continuous bombardment. It underscores their unwavering commitment to saving lives despite the destruction of healthcare infrastructure and personal risks involved.
2025-s-0173.impact: This coverage has been pivotal in bringing global attention to the dire state of Gaza’s healthcare system, emphasising the resilience and dedication of its medical staff.
2025-s-0173.tools: Animation, Adobe Creative Suite, Google Sheets
2025-s-0173.authors: Hanna Duggal, Mohamed Hussein and Soha Elghany
2025-s-0173.summaryJa: この記事は,ガザの医療従事者が継続中のイスラエル攻撃中に直面する悲惨な状況について深く調べています.非常に人間的でデータ豊かなこの機能は,医療インフラストラクチャの破壊と個人リスクに関係なく,生命を救うための彼らの揺るぎないコミットメントを強調しています.
2025-s-0173.impactJa: この報道は,ガザの医療システムの悲惨な状況に世界的な注目を集める上で重要な役割を果たし,医療スタッフの回復力と献身を強調しています.

2025-s-0174.summary: We have had more than 50 years of scientific data, economic arguments, books, petitions, documentaries, global resolutions. We know our planet’s ecosystem is breaking down…much of the destruction is irreparable. So, why haven’t things changed faster? This series is the result of dozens of interviews with climatologists, activists and specialists around the world. At the centre of our conversations has been the principle of climate justice, because all too often it’s not prioritised in these kinds of discussions…and it should be.
2025-s-0174.impact: This 10-part TV series and digital adaptation has significantly influenced global conversations on climate change by examining the social, economic, and political forces hindering effective action. Hosted by journalist Ali Rae, the series delves into topics such as the environmental impact of militarism, the role of industrial agriculture in biodiversity loss, and the psychological barriers to climate action. By combining in-depth analysis with accessible storytelling, ”All Hail The Planet” has engaged a diverse audience, sparking discussions on social media and prompting calls for systemic change to address the climate crisis. The series has been instrumental in highlighting the interconnectedness of various global systems and their collective impact on the environment, encouraging viewers to reconsider their perspectives and advocate for comprehensive solutions.
2025-s-0174.tools: Animation, 3D modeling, AI/Machine learning, Sensor, Personalisation, Drone, QGIS, Adobe Creative Suite, Microsoft Excel, Google Sheets, CSV
2025-s-0174.authors: Ali Rae, Hanna Duggal and Konstantinos Antonopoulos
2025-s-0174.summaryJa: 気候学者の皆さん,このシリーズは,世界中の気候学者や活動家,専門家と数十回のインタビューの結果です. 気候学者の皆さん,このシリーズは,地球上の気候学者の皆さん,活動家,専門家とインタビューの成果です. 気候変動の正義の原則が私たちの会話の中心でしたなぜなら,しばしばこのような議論において優先事項が与えられていないからです.
2025-s-0174.impactJa: この10部分のテレビシリーズとデジタル適応は,効果的な行動に障害を与える社会,経済,政治的力を調べることで,気候変動に関する世界的な会話に大きく影響を与えた.ジャーナリストアリ・レイが主催するこのシリーズは,軍事主義の環境影響,生物多様性の喪失における産業農業の役割,気候変動への心理的な障壁などの話題に深く取り組んでいます. 詳細な分析とアクセス可能なストーリーテリングを組み合わせることで,『All Hail The Planet』は多様な視聴者を巻き込み,ソーシャルメディアで議論を挑み,気候変動危機に対処するためのシステム変化の呼びかけを促した.このシリーズは,さまざまなグローバルシステムの相互関係と環境への集団的影響を強調し,視聴者を彼らの視点を再考し,包括的な解決策を主張するよう促した.

2025-s-0175.summary: The four-part series, ”Mind the Tap: Water Security in a Thirsty Metropolis,” explores how rising temperatures over the past decade, intensified by extreme weather events such as El Niño, pose a significant threat to water security in Metro Manila and surrounding communities. This is particularly evident when Angat Dam—which supplies 98 percent of Metro Manila’s potable water—breaches its minimum operating levels during the dry season. The series also highlights how Metro Manila’s growing population affects the efficiency of water distribution and how inequality determines who does and does not have access to water, both in times of abundance and scarcity.
2025-s-0175.impact: It is worth noting that the lowest water level of 173.20 meters in 2024 was significantly higher than in 2019, when Angat Dam recorded its lowest level at 157.96 meters, despite the threats of El Niño. While this welcome outcome may not be directly attributed to the publication of the story, raising awareness about the issue could have encouraged the public to be more mindful of their water consumption and may have contributed, in a small way, to more efficient water management. The story also amplified calls from communities severely impacted by the 2019 water cuts for the government and water concessionaires to improve water management and governance to mitigate future threats and prevent a recurrence of the 2019 crisis, where certain barangays went without water for more than a week. Additionally, solutions and calls to action were highlighted to emphasize how individual efforts can contribute to water conservation, especially as the Philippines faced the threat of El Niño in 2024.
2025-s-0175.tools: Animation, Drone, Scraping, Adobe Creative Suite, Google Sheets, CSV
2025-s-0175.authors: AUTHOR: Maria Virginia Cruz Sy (Gigie Cruz), EDITED BY: Eva Constantaras, Jamaine Punzalan and Fernando G. Sepe Jr., DATA VISUALIZATION: Lu Min Lwin, Thibi, ART AND GRAPHICS BY: Pamela Denice Ramos, DEVELOPED BY: Regie Francisco, ADDITIONAL PHOTOS: Mark Demayo and Val Cuenca,
2025-s-0175.summaryJa: <unk>Mind the Tap: Water Security in a Thirsty Metropolis (水道管を意識する:渇きのある都市における水の安全) という4部シリーズでは,エルニノなどの極端な天気現象によって加劇された過去10年間で気温の上昇が,メトロ・マニラと周辺地域の水の安全に重大な脅威をもたらす方法について探討しています.これは,メトロ・マニラの飲料水の98%を供給するアンガットダムが乾季中に最低運用水準を破ったときに特に顕著です. このシリーズはまた,メトロ・マニラ市の人口の増加が水分配給の効率に影響し,不平等が豊富な水と乏しい水分の時代に誰が水にアクセスできるのか,誰ができないかを決定する方法を強調しています.
2025-s-0175.impactJa: 2024年の最低水位173.20mは,2019年よりかなり高く,アンガットダムではエルニノの脅威にもかかわらず157.96mで最低水位を記録しました. この歓迎すべき結果が物語の出版に直接関係しないかもしれませんがこの問題に対する意識を高めることで市民が水消費に意識を深めることができず,水管理をより効率的にするためにわずかな貢献をすることが可能でした. この話はまた,2019年の水削減によって深刻な影響を受けた地域から政府や水譲渡業者に対し,将来の脅威を緩和し,2019年の危機の再発を防ぐために水管理と治理を改善するよう呼びかけました. さらに,フィリピンが2024年にエルニノの脅威に直面しているため,個々の努力が水保全に貢献できる方法を強調するために,解決策と行動への呼びかけが強調されました.

2025-s-0176.summary: After the collapse of the Black Sea Grain Initiative in the summer of 2023, virtually no vessels were leaving Ukraine’s Black Sea ports, under threat by the Russian navy. Our story looked at how Ukraine was able to re-open this crucial shipping corridor for grain, scaring off Russian warships through the use of relatively inexpensive naval drones, crafting an innovative insurance agreement, and establishing a new shipping corridor. Our analysis of ship tracking data showed that by early 2024, vessel traffic out of Odesa-area ports was back to nearly pre-war levels.
2025-s-0176.impact: The story was well-read and received and drove conversation around what, at the time, was a fairly understated front of the war. We noticed more coverage of the recovering grain exports in subsequent weeks, such as a story by the New York Times published on May 12.
2025-s-0176.tools: Animation, 3D modeling, Canvas, Json, CSV, OpenStreetMap, Python, Node.js, React, Mapbox, Ship tracking, Geospatial analysis
2025-s-0176.authors: Sam Learner, Sam Joiner, Dan Clark, Ian Bott, Irene de la Torre Arenas
2025-s-0176.summaryJa: 2023年の夏にブラックシー穀物イニシアチブが崩壊した後,ロシア海軍による脅威にさらされたウクライナの黒海港をほとんど船は離さなかった.我々の物語はウクライナがこの重要な穀物輸送廊下を再開し,比較的安価な海軍ドローンを使用することによってロシアの戦艦を脅かすこと,革新的な保険契約を作成し,新しい航海廊下を確立することを見ました. 船舶追跡データ分析によると 2024年初頭までにオデッサ港からの船舶輸送はほぼ戦前水準に戻った
2025-s-0176.impactJa: この物語はよく読みられ,受付され,その時に戦争の比較的軽視された面について議論を進めました.その後の週に穀物輸出の回復については,ニューヨークタイムズの 5 月 12 日に掲載された記事のように,さらに報道されました.

2025-s-0177.summary: At the start of summer, Gaza’s fields are usually bursting with ripening crops and fruits of all colours, scents and sizes. But amid Israel’s war on Gaza, abundant harvests have given way to devastation and a dire humanitarian crisis. In this story, Al Jazeera’s digital investigation team, Sanad, analysed dozens of satellite images, revealing that more than 60 percent of Gaza’s farmland—vital for feeding its war-ravaged population—has been damaged or destroyed by Israeli attacks. The story integrates this satellite analysis with visually striking before-and-after sliders and features expert insights on the long-term impact of Israeli bombings on Gaza’s soil.
2025-s-0177.impact: The story has helped quantify the extent of Israel’s ongoing destruction of the Gaza Strip and has raised global awareness of the damage to Gaza’s farmland and its impact on food security.
2025-s-0177.tools: AI/Machine learning, Drone, QGIS, Adobe Creative Suite, Google Sheets
2025-s-0177.summaryJa: 夏の初めには,ガザの田舎は,通常,あらゆる色,香り,サイズで熟した作物や果物で溢れていて,しかしイスラエルがガザに対する戦争中に,豊富な収穫は破壊と深刻な人道危機に転じています. この記事ではアルジャジーラのデジタル調査チームであるサンアッドが数十枚の衛星画像を分析し,戦争被害を受けた住民を養うために不可欠なガザの農地の約60%がイスラエルによる攻撃によって損傷または破壊されたことを明らかにした.この記事は,この衛星分析を視覚的に目立つ前後スライダーと統合し,イスラエルによるガザの土地への長期影響に関する専門家洞察を紹介しています.
2025-s-0177.impactJa: この話は,ガザの農地への被害とその食料安全保障への影響に対する世界的な認識を高め,ガザの破壊の規模を定量化するのに役立ちました.

2025-s-0178.summary: Visualising the War in Sudan: Conflict, Control, and Displacement, offers a comprehensive analysis of the ongoing conflict in Sudan, which has led to the world’s worst internal displacement crisis, with at least 14 million people uprooted from their homes. The project meticulously maps nearly 9,000 recorded attacks between April 2023 and October 2024, highlighting that more than half occurred in the capital, Khartoum, with significant violence also in Gezira State and North Darfur. By presenting detailed data on attack locations, casualty figures, and displacement patterns, the feature provides an in-depth understanding of the devastating impact on Sudanese civilians.
2025-s-0178.impact: The project was able to shed light on Sudan’s devastating yet underreported conflict and displacement crisis, using data visualisation to make the scale of violence and human suffering more accessible and urgent.
2025-s-0178.tools: Adobe Creative Suite, Google Sheets, R, RStudio
2025-s-0178.summaryJa: スーダン戦争:紛争,制御,移住をイメージする本書は,スーダンにおける紛争を全面的に分析し,少なくとも1400万人の人々が家から追い出されたことで,世界で最も深刻な国内難民危機を引き起こした. このプロジェクトは2023年4月から2024年10月までの間に記録された約9,000件の攻撃を細心の描写し,その半分以上が首都カルツウムで発生し,ゲジラ州と北ダルフールでも顕著な暴力が起きたことを強調しています.攻撃場所,犠牲者数値,避難パターンに関する詳細なデータを提示することで,この機能はスーダン市民に対する破壊的な影響について深く理解しています.
2025-s-0178.impactJa: プロジェクトでは,暴力と人間の苦しみの規模をよりアクセス可能かつ緊急にするために,データビジュアライゼーションを使用して,スーダンにおける破壊的な,しかし未報告された紛争と移住危機を明るみに出ることができました.

2025-s-0179.summary: This investigation (originally in Italian) looks into how commercial interests decimate Italy’s remaining wetlands, as national authorities ignore this ongoing exploitation. From unwanted to protected, wetlands - salt marshes, lagoons, deltas, swamps - are powerful natural weapons to mitigate the effects of the climate crisis. Combining data science, AI analysis of satellite imagery and field reporting, we focused on the Oristano’s wetlands (Sardinia), where there is a long-standing plan for a much-discussed protected area, and the saltmarsh in Cervia (Emilia-Romagna) affected by disastrous flooding. We revealed that political and commercial interests prevented the application of effective protective policies, further damaging the environment.
2025-s-0179.impact: The project was published on Facta.eu, an independent media applying the scientific method to investigative and data journalism, in syndication with Il Bo Live, an award-winning magazine edited by the University of Padua and the largest cultural digital magazine in Italy with 280.000+ average daily users, 50/50 gender split and a strong readership in the 25-40 years of age. The investigation also reached Facta.eu’s community of researchers, scientists, activists, NGO representatives and teachers. We received good qualitative feedback on the project’s results, which were used at the local level for advocacy activities to protect wetlands. Moreover, readers have suggested further investigation of Italian wetlands, and we are exploring opportunities to expand the project. Some of the investigation’s results were published in the independent magazine Indip, focusing on investigative journalism in Sardinia and strongly connected to local communities on the island. We gave several seminars and practical sessions to present the project’s steps and results at the SISSA post-graduate School in Trieste. The investigation was also presented during the 2024 Climate Arena Conference in Bologna. The panel included two journalists and a data scientist involved in the project, who discussed their investigative approaches encompassing data science, satellite journalism and field reporting.
2025-s-0179.tools: Scraping, QGIS, Google Sheets, CSV, AI analysis of satellite imagery
2025-s-0179.authors: Elisabetta Tola, Giulia Bonelli, Benedetta Pagni, Raffaele Angius, Andrea Carboni
2025-s-0179.summaryJa: この調査は,イタリアの商業的な利益が,この継続的な搾取を無視しているため,残りの湿地をどのように減少させたのかを調査しています. データ科学,衛星画像のAI分析,フィールドレポートを組み合わせて私たちはオリスタノ<unk>の湿地 (サーディニア) に焦点を当てましたそこは長い間議論されている保護区の計画であり災害的な洪水の影響を受けたセルビアの塩沼 (エミリア・ロマニャ) でした政治や商業的利益は効果的な保護政策の適用を妨げ,環境をさらに傷つけました
2025-s-0179.impactJa: プロジェクトは調査とデータジャーナリズムに科学的な方法を適用する独立したメディアである Facta.euで出版されました Il Bo Liveはパドワ大学で出版された賞受賞雑誌であり,イタリア最大の文化デジタル誌で平均日用ユーザー28万以上,性別分割50/50と25-40歳の強い読者数です. 調査はFact.euの研究者や科学者,活動家,NGO代表者,教師のコミュニティにも届きました. 我々はプロジェクトの結果について良い質的なフィードバックを得ました. これは湿地保護のための地方レベルの宣導活動に使用されました. さらに,読者はイタリアの湿地についてのさらなる調査を提案し,プロジェクトを拡大する機会を探しています. 調査の結果の一部は独立雑誌Indipで公開され,サーディニアにおける調査ジャーナリズムに焦点を当て,島内の地元のコミュニティと強く結びついています. 我々は,トリエストのSISSA大学院でプロジェクトのステップと結果を紹介するためにいくつかのセミナーと実践セッションを開催しました. 調査は2024年のボロニャの気候アリーナ会議中に発表されました. プロジェクトに参加した2人のジャーナリストとデータサイエンティストが参加し,データ科学,衛星ジャーナリズム,フィールドレポートを含む調査アプローチを議論しました

2025-s-0180.summary: The article ”All the Ways in Which Israel Is Destroying Gaza” analyzes the devastation in the Gaza Strip after six months of conflict that began on October 7, 2023. It highlights the systematic destruction of essential infrastructure such as hospitals and schools, as well as the loss of cultural heritage, which has turned Gaza into an ”unlivable place.” Additionally, it highlights with data the deaths of approximately 33,000 people and the proposal of Israeli real estate projects over Gaza’s ruins, suggesting an intention to rebuild in a way that could significantly alter the identity and future of the Palestinian enclave.
2025-s-0180.impact: The article ”Todas las maneras en las que Israel está destruyendo Gaza” significantly shapes public perception by exposing the scale of destruction, the loss of cultural heritage, and the humanitarian crisis. It raises awareness, challenges mainstream narratives, and increases global scrutiny of Israel’s actions. Readers who may have been uninformed are confronted with the depth of the crisis, potentially shifting opinions and fueling political discourse. Beyond informing the public, the article influences policymakers, NGOs, and advocacy groups, contributing to calls for humanitarian aid, ceasefires, and legal action. It strengthens activism by providing material for protests, petitions, and human rights campaigns, amplifying demands for accountability. However, it also fuels debate and polarization, reinforcing or challenging existing beliefs. While some view it as an essential exposé of war crimes, others may see it as biased. This dynamic sparks broader discussions on media framing and international responses. Ultimately, the article’s impact extends beyond reporting; it shapes narratives, influences policy debates, and mobilizes action. By highlighting not just destruction but also the erasure of Palestinian identity, it deepens the conversation on justice, human rights, and the long-term consequences of war.
2025-s-0180.tools: Animation, Scraping, QGIS, Adobe Creative Suite, Google Sheets, CSV, OpenStreetMap
2025-s-0180.authors: Emma Esser Díaz Alicia Alamillos Sofía Sisqués Ana Ruiz Mónica Redondo Luis Rodríguez
2025-s-0180.summaryJa: 記事"イスラエルがガザを破壊するすべての方法"は,2023年10月7日に始まった6カ月間の紛争後,ガザの破壊を分析しています病院や学校などの重要なインフラが体系的に破壊され,文化遺産が失われ,ガザを"生きられない場所"に変えたことを強調する. さらに,約33,000人の死亡と,ガザの廃墟に対するイスラエルの不動産プロジェクト提案をデータで強調し,パレスチナのアイデンティティと未来を大きく変えることができる方法で再建する意図を示唆しています.
2025-s-0180.impactJa: 記事"イスラエルがガザを破壊するあらゆる方法"は,破壊の規模,文化遺産の喪失,人道危機を暴露することによって,公衆の認識を大きく形作る. それは,意識を高め,主流の物語を挑発し,イスラエルの行動のグローバルな調査を増加させる. 危機の深さに直面し,潜在的に意見を転換し,政治論議を助長する. 市民を情報化するだけでなく,政策立案者,NGO,そして擁護団体に影響を与え,人道支援,停戦,法的な行動への呼びかけに貢献しています. 抗議,請願,人権キャンペーンのための資料を提供することによって,説明責任の要求を拡大することによって,活動力を強化します. しかし,それは議論と偏分化にも助長します. このダイナミックはメディアの枠組みと国際的対応に関するより広範な議論を引き起こす. 最終的に,記事の影響は報道を超えて広がります. それは物語を形作,政策議論に影響を与え,行動を動かす.

2025-s-0181.summary: This article discusses about female esports players who have difficulty getting space in professional tournaments. This difficulty is shown in several aspects that are clearly and clearly visible. First, the prizes for esports tournaments for women are never as big as men. Second, there are no special regulations related to esports tournaments specifically for women. Finally, women choose to give up on being professional esports players, because their income is not enough to support their lives.
2025-s-0181.impact: I find it hard to say that this article has had a big and widespread impact. While I interviewed players, regulators and game developers, none of them were aware of the major issues that women face in the esports scene. This is due to the normalization of masculine behavior and marginalization in the name of an open space that has standards that are not friendly to women. The only impact I can achieve at this point is that female esports players are starting to understand the context of the economic violence they experience. Of course, in this case I want to push this issue in a more serious direction regarding having a tournament specifically for female esports players
2025-s-0181.authors: Nenden Sekar Arum, Adi (editor) Yazid (Writer and Interviewer)
2025-s-0181.summaryJa: この記事では,プロのトーナメントにスペースを得ることが困難である女性エススポーツ選手について説明します.この困難は,はっきりと目に見えるいくつかの側面で示されています.一つは,女性のためのエススポーツトーナメントの賞金は,男性ほど大きくありません.二つは,特に女性向けのエススポーツトーナメントに関連する特別な規制はありません. 最後に,女性たちはプロのスポーツ選手を諦めようとします彼らの収入は生活維持に十分ではないからです
2025-s-0181.impactJa: この記事には大きな影響が広がったとは言えません.私はプレイヤーや規制当局やゲーム開発者にインタビューしたものの,誰も女性たちがエススポーツの舞台で直面する主要な問題について知っていませんでした.これは,女性に友好的な基準のないオープンスペースの名前に男性行為の正常化と疎外化によるものです. 女性のeスポーツ選手が経験する経済暴力の背景を理解し始めていることですもちろん,このケースでは,この問題をより深刻な方向に押し上げたいと思います.

2025-s-0182.summary: In the largest public analysis of Israeli military strike footage, The Killings They Tweeted developed a unique data-led investigative process to review hundreds of clips of airstrikes in Gaza released by the Israeli military. Through this novel approach, the investigation uncovered the killing of more that 400 civilians from strikes in Gaza that the Israeli military itself published footage of on social media. Made by the investigations team of the civilian harm watchdog Airwars, in collaboration with Sky News, the 20-minute film merges 3D reconstructions and witness testimonies, revealing how the videos could ultimately be used against Israel in court.
2025-s-0182.impact: The impact of the film crossed social, legal and political boundaries with a major influence in the civilian harm field. The innovative technical approach of the project prompted a feature by the Nieman Journalism Lab at Harvard, expanding on the originality of our method in determining civilian casualties from Israeli strike footage. In January 2025, CBS 60 minutes recreated a section of the film investigating the Al-Taj strike - pushing OSINT driven-data to a mainstream audience. Crucially, the transparency of our methodology resulted in the findings being used to support major legal mechanisms, which we would be happy to explain to the panel in a private setting. Additionally, the film focused on a family who lost 15 members in an Israeli strike on the Al-Taj Tower. This interview formed the heart of the film, which was well received by loved ones of the family.
2025-s-0182.tools: Animation, 3D modeling, QGIS, Json, Adobe Creative Suite, Google Sheets, CSV, OpenStreetMap, Google Earth Pro, Wikimapia, Svelte.js, Figma, Blender

2025-s-0182.summaryJa: イスラエル軍の最大規模の公開のイスラエル軍の攻撃映像分析において,ザ・キリングス・ザ・ツイートは,イスラエル軍が公開したガザの空爆の何百もの映像をレビューするために,データ主導のユニークな調査プロセスを開発した.この新しいアプローチを通じて,調査は,イスラエル軍がソーシャルメディアで公開したガザの攻撃で400人以上の民間人の殺害を明らかにした. 民間被害監視団"エアウォーズ"の調査チームによってスカイ・ニュースと協力して制作された20分間のこの映画は 3D再構築と目撃者の証言を融合させ, 最終的にイスラエルに対してどのように使用されるかを明らかにしています.
2025-s-0182.impactJa: 市民の被害分野に大きな影響を持つ社会,法律,政治的な境界を越えたこの映画の影響は,このプロジェクトの技術革新的なアプローチにより,ハーバード大学のニーマンジャーナリズムラボが,イスラエルの攻撃映像から民間人の犠牲者を決定する我々の方法のオリジナリティを拡大した. 2025年1月,CBS60分ではアルタージストライキを調査する映画の一部を再現し,OSINTによるデータを主流の観客に提供しました.重要なことに,我々の方法論の透明性は,主要な法的メカニズムを支援するために発見が使用され,私的な設定でパネルに説明することを喜んでお伝えしました.さらに,この映画はアルタージ塔に対するイスラエル攻撃で15人の家族を失った家族に焦点を当てました. このインタビューは映画の核心となり家族の親戚が好評をいただきました

2025-s-0183.summary: A equipe revelou, em uma investigação inédita baseada na Lei de Acesso à Informação, a escalada do tráfico internacional de drogas no Brasil. Entre 2021 e 2023, mais de 100 toneladas de cocaína foram apreendidas em portos e aeroportos do país, com destino a 92 países, sendo a Europa o principal mercado. A reportagem destacou o crescimento alarmante do tráfico para Ásia e Oceania, com aumento de 3.600% nas apreensões para Hong Kong. Além dos dados, a equipe acompanhou prisões em flagrante de pessoas em situação de vulnerabilidade, revelando o papel das mulas do tráfico no crime organizado globalizado.
2025-s-0183.impact: A investigação trouxe à tona dados inéditos que mudaram a compreensão do tráfico internacional de drogas no Brasil. A série revelou o crescimento exponencial da exportação de cocaína para mercados emergentes, especialmente Ásia e Oceania, e mostrou como o Brasil se tornou um dos principais corredores do tráfico global. O impacto do trabalho foi imediato: autoridades de segurança utilizaram os dados da reportagem para embasar investigações e reforçar o monitoramento em portos e aeroportos. Depois da reportagem, instalaram scanners corporais capazes de identificar drogas engolidas. Especialistas e políticos citaram os achados para defender mudanças em políticas públicas e um maior controle nas fronteiras. Além do impacto institucional, a reportagem também gerou um debate social importante sobre a exploração de pessoas vulneráveis pelo crime organizado. Ao mostrar casos reais de grávidas e pessoas em situação de extrema pobreza recrutadas como ”mulas”, o trabalho expôs a vulnerabilidade social. A investigação demonstrou o papel essencial do jornalismo de dados na segurança pública, ao revelar padrões de tráfico e pressionar por ações concretas. Além disso, inspirou outros veículos de imprensa a aprofundarem investigações sobre o narcotráfico e suas conexões internacionais.

2025-s-0183.impactJa: 研究はブラジルにおける国際麻薬取引の理解を変化させた未経験のデータを明らかにし,特にアジアとオセアニアの新興市場へのコカイン輸出の急激な成長を明らかにし,ブラジルが世界の主要麻薬取引の走廊の1つになったことを示しました報告の影響はすぐにありましたセキュリティ当局は報告のデータを調査を基盤に活用し港や空港の監視を強化しました報告の後飲み込まれた薬物を特定できる体検器を設置しました専門家や政治家たちは公共政策の変更と国境の規制を擁護するために発見を引用しました組織犯罪による脆弱な人々の搾取について重要な社会議論をもたらした. <unk>mulasのような雇用された妊婦や極度の貧困層の実例を紹介することで,研究は社会的脆弱性を暴露した. 特定行動の圧力を集し,密輸のパターンを明らかにし,公共の安全におけるデータジャーナリズムの重要な役割を調査した. また,他のメディアが麻薬取引とその国際関連に関する調査を深めるよう励まし出しました.

2025-s-0184.summary: Using Freedom of Information requests and extensive research in the British Newspaper Archive, I compiled a database of 1,000 UK murders that have never been solved. The timeline of 1,000 murders was published as a stand alone publication alongside 21 in-depth features covering many of the cases in the database. I then pinpointed the location of all 1,000 murders to produce an interactive map which was published on Reach regional websites with information about the cold cases. The final series covered every police force in England, Scotland and Wales.
2025-s-0184.impact: The print edition was one of Reach’s best selling stand alone titles last year, selling more than 14,000 copies, which outstripped the daily circulation of every Reach regional title, and all but three regional newspapers in the UK. Reach regional brands also went into their own archives and linked previous reporting to the interactive map. More than a dozen regional titles have published articles based on my research including the Manchester Evening News, Wales Online, Liverpool Echo, Birmingham Live, Chronicle (Newcastle) Live, Bristol Live, Grimsby Live, North Wales Live, Cornwall Live, Devon Live, Gloucestershire Live and Yorkshire Live. The features, timeline, and interactive map shone a light on many shocking crimes that had been largely forgotten about and in some cases, had not been covered in decades. It brought these cases back into the public focus and highlighted the ongoing wait for sustice endured by many families. Data graphics used in the project provided supporting evidence for an included interview with criminologist Professor David Wilson, who warned that at least two serial killers are likely to be still on the loose in Britain. A second edition, podcast, and weekly newsletter are now planned as follow-ups to the original work.
2025-s-0184.tools: AI/Machine learning, Json, Microsoft Excel, Google Sheets, CSV, OpenStreetMap
2025-s-0184.summaryJa: 報道の自由の要請と英国新聞アーカイブでの広範な調査を活用して,私は未解決の英国殺人事件1,000件をデータベースにまとめました 1,000件の殺人事件のタイムラインはデータベースの多くの事件をカバーする 21件の詳細な機能とともに,単独出版として公開されました. その後 1,000件の殺人事件の場所を特定しインタラクティブな地図を作成しましたこの地図はRichの地域ウェブサイトに掲載され冷たい事件に関する情報も掲載されました最終シリーズはイングランド,スコットランド,ウェールズのすべての警察を対象としたものです
2025-s-0184.impactJa: 印刷版は昨年,Rachのベストセラーシングルタイトルの一つであり,1万4千枚以上を販売し,Rachの地域タイトルと3本を除くすべての地域新聞の日刊を上回った.Rachの地域ブランドも独自のアーカイブに登入し,以前のレポートをインタラクティブな地図にリンクしました. 地域刊行は10以上の記事で,私の研究に基づく記事を掲載しています.Manchester Evening News,Wales Online,Liverpool Echo,Birmingham Live,Chronicle (Newcastle) Live,Bristol Live,Grimsby Live,North Wales Live,Cornwall Live,Devon Live,Glocestershire Live,Yorkshire Liveなど. 犯罪学者のデイヴィッド・ウィルソン教授とのインタビューの裏付けを図るデータグラフィックが提供された.彼は少なくとも2人の連続殺人犯がまだイギリスで自由に出かけている可能性が警告した.第二版,ポッドキャスト,および毎週新聞が現在オリジナル作品のフォローアップとして計画されている.

2025-s-0185.summary: Know Their Names: The Palestinian Journalists Killed by Israel in Gaza,” commemorates the lives of more than 200 Palestinian journalists killed during Israel’s war on Gaza. The project provides detailed accounts of each journalist’s personal and professional background, highlighting their dedication to reporting under perilous conditions. Through illustrations and personal narratives the story underscores the profound risks media professionals face in Gaza and the significant impact of their loss on both the journalistic community and the broader society.
2025-s-0185.impact: The project had a profound impact by preserving the legacy of Palestinian journalists killed in Gaza. It raised global awareness of the extreme dangers faced by media professionals in conflict zones, sparking international discussions on press freedom, journalist safety and the targeting of reporters.
2025-s-0185.tools: AI/Machine learning, Adobe Creative Suite, Google Sheets
2025-s-0185.summaryJa: 名前は知れ:イスラエルがガザで殺害したパレスチナジャーナリストは,ガザに対するイスラエル戦争中に殺害された200人以上のパレスチナジャーナリストの命を記念する作品です.このプロジェクトは,危険な状況下で報道に献身する各ジャーナリストの個人・職業的な背景を詳細に説明しています. 物語はイラストや個人的な物語を通して,ガザにおけるメディア専門家が直面する深刻なリスクと,彼らの損失がジャーナリストコミュニティと社会全体に及ぼす大きな影響を強調しています.
2025-s-0185.impactJa: このプロジェクトはガザで殺害されたパレスチナ人のジャーナリストの遺産を保存することで深い影響を与えた. 紛争地帯におけるメディア専門家が直面する極端な危険について,世界的な認識を高め,報道の自由,ジャーナリストの安全,ジャーナリストの標的と国際的な議論を招いた.

2025-s-0186.summary: Portugal viu-se a braços com eleições antecipadas, depois da queda do Governo socialista. Depois de uma maioria absoluta em 2022, as sondagens apontavam para uma mudança de cenário. Tal veio a confirmar-se. Os ventos mudaram de sentido — e o rumo do país também. Mapeamos as vitórias e derrotas eleitorais no regresso social-democrata ao poder.
2025-s-0186.impact: Este projecto foi publicado três dias depois da noite eleitoral e debruçou-se maioritariamente sobre os fenómenos locais de alguns partidos – mas não só. Procuramos também encontrar respostas para algumas das perguntas que surgem nas primeiras horas após o encerramento das urnas. Para tal, cruzamos os resultados eleitorais com indicadores socioeconómicos. O artigo foi dos mais lidos nos dias que se seguiram à noite eleitoral.
2025-s-0186.authors: Rui Barros, José Volta e Pinto
2025-s-0186.summaryJa: ポーチは社会主義政権の崩壊後,提前選挙に手を伸ばした. 2022年の絶対多数を獲得した後に,世論調査は景色転換を指摘した.これは確認された.風が方向を変えた.また国の方向も変わってしまった.社会民主党が権力を回復する選挙の勝利と敗北を地図に映し出しました.
2025-s-0186.impactJa: このプロジェクトは選挙の夜から3日後に公開され,主に一部の政党の地方現象を研究した.しかし,それだけでなく.投票終了後最初の数時間で起きる質問の答えも探しました.そのために,選挙結果を社会経済指標と交差しました.この記事は選挙の夜に続く数日に最も読まれました.

2025-s-0187.summary: Este trabalho avaliava a compatibilidade do leitor com os programas eleitorais dos partidos com assento parlamentar que concorreram nas eleições legislativas portuguesas de 2024. Recorrendo a inteligência artificial, analisamos os programas eleitorais para identificar as principais propostas e estabelecer matrizes políticas para cada partido, permitindo ao utilizador explorar e compreender melhor as propostas dos partidos e perceber a sua compatibilidade com os candidatos.
2025-s-0187.impact: A ferramenta teve um impacto imediato nas discussões diárias sobre as eleições. Foi amplamente partilhado pelos leitores nas redes sociais, com um feedback geralmente muito positivo relativamente aos resultados de compatibilidade e aquilo que eram as ideias preconcebidas de quem respondia às perguntas – um sinal de que a elaboração do algoritmo foi bem-sucedida. A dimensão da base de dados das medidas disponíveis para testar a compatibilidade também foi um factor diferenciador destacado pelos leitores - recebemos, inclusive, e-mails de utilizadores que se ”queixavam” de não conseguir terminar o quiz (não é nada fácil chegar ao fim de cinco mil medidas). Outra prova do impacto foram as métricas de acessos ao trabalho, que mostraram uma procura pela página (pelas palavras “Dating eleitoral”) nos motores de pesquisa. A isto também se deve o facto de este ser o segundo trabalho nestes moldes – o dating leitoral aqui submetido é uma versão melhorada (bastante mais complexa e sofisticada) de uma outra news application que elaboramos em 2022. Apesar de um contratempo na monitorização do tráfego durante as primeiras horas de publicação, o Dating eleitoral acumulou perto de 1,2 milhões de pageviews e foi utilizado por um total de quase 47 mil utilizadores.
2025-s-0187.authors: Rui Barros, José Volta e Pinto e Ana Maria Henriques
2025-s-0187.summaryJa: この研究は,ポルトガルの2024年議会選挙に参戦した議席政党の選挙プログラムとの読者の互換性を評価した.人工知能を用いて,我々は選挙プログラムを分析し,主要な提案を特定し,各政党のための政治マトリクスを確立し,ユーザが政党の提案をより良く探求し理解し,候補者との互換性を認識できるようにした.
2025-s-0187.impactJa: このツールが選挙に関する日常議論に直接的な影響を与えた. ソーシャルメディアの読者によって広く共有され, 互換性結果や質問に答える人の偏見について良く反論された. アルゴリズムの作成が成功したことを示す兆候です. 対応性をテストするための測定法データベースの規模も読者によって強調された特徴でした - テストを完了できないことを <unk>苦<unk>しくしたユーザーからのメールもありました (5,000の測定法を完了することは簡単ではありません). 影響の証拠は,検索エンジンでページ検索 (選挙人デਟਿੰਗ) を示した作業アクセスメトリックでした. 選挙人デートは 2022年に作成した別のニュースアプリケーションの改良版 (かなり複雑で洗練された) です. 公開の初期にトラフィックモニタリングの不況にもかかわらず,選挙人デートは1,200万ページビュー近くを集め,合計で47,000人に使用されました.

2025-s-0188.summary: For three days, Al Jazeera followed three families in Gaza to document how they are coping with hardly any food. Through compelling visuals and detailed calorie tracking, the project highlights the dire living conditions and the stark gap between available food and basic nutritional needs. The story offered a deeply human perspective on the reality of food deprivation, transforming an often abstract issue into a tangible, lived experience.
2025-s-0188.impact: The project had a significant impact by raising global awareness of the severe hunger crisis in Gaza. Through its visual storytelling and detailed calorie tracking, it humanised the struggles of Palestinian families, making the crisis more tangible for international audiences. The coverage sparked discussions on social media and was cited in several stories including in medical journals. e.g. https://jme.bmj.com/content/50/5/289
2025-s-0188.authors: Maram Humaid, Abdelhakim Abu Riash and Alia Chughtai
2025-s-0188.summaryJa: 3日間,アルジャジーラはガザの3つの家族を追跡し,ほとんど食べられない状況にどのように対処しているのかを記録した.説得力のある映像や詳細なカロリー追跡を通じて,このプロジェクトは,生活環境の悲惨さと,利用可能な食料と基本的な栄養の必要との間の大きなギャップを強調した.この物語は,食物不足の現実に対する深い人間的な視点を提供し,しばしば抽象的な問題を,実感的で生きた経験に変えた.
2025-s-0188.impactJa: このプロジェクトは,ガザにおける深刻な飢餓危機に対する世界的な意識を高めることで,大きな影響を与えた.視覚的な物語と詳細なカロリー追跡を通じて,パレスチナ人の家族の闘争を人間化し,国際観客にとって危機をより知覚的にした.この報道はソーシャルメディアで議論を挑み,医学雑誌を含むいくつかの記事に引用された.例えば https://jme.bmj.com/content/50/5/289

2025-s-0189.summary: What’s behind the violence against Indigenous people in the Brazilian Amazon? This investigation revealed a pattern of targeted killings of Indigenous Guajajara amid the expansion of illegal cattle ranching and logging in the Arariboia Indigenous Territory. The findings unfolded several dozen illegal activities in the region and made a correlation with crimes that remain unpunished. With four Guajajara people killed and three others surviving death attempts, 2023 marked the deadliest year for Arariboia since 2016. Between 1991 and 2023, 38 Guajajara Indigenous were killed in Arariboia, almost half of the killings in Maranhão state. None of the perpetrators were tried.
2025-s-0189.impact: The Federal Police, the Federal Public Prosecutor’s Office and Brazil’s federal environmental agency IBAMA said the investigation’s findings are unprecedented and will be key in operations to remove illegal cattle from the Arariboia. On Feb. 10 they launched an operation to remove invaders from Arariboia using information from this investigation. The Guajajara people also used the investigation in their request to the Inter-American Commission on Human Rights to protect Arariboia. Federal prosecutor Alfredo Falcão, who leads the legal case of the murder of Indigenous leader Paulo Paulino Guajajara, said the investigation revealed an excellent correlation between illegal deforestation and killing of Indigenous people and he’ll use it to help Paulo’s case. In December 2024, the investigation won an Honorable Mention in Brazil’s ARI Banrisul Journalism Award. It was also quoted in the book What Will YOUR Legacy Be? – Conversations With Global Game Changers About The Climate Crisis” released in the UK in February. The book is number 46 on Amazon for Hot New Reads and is already in reprint. In January, it was taken to the World Economic Forum, where it was presented to sustainability leaders. The book will also be released in the US and India.
2025-s-0189.tools: Drone, Scraping, QGIS, Microsoft Excel, Google Sheets, CSV
2025-s-0189.authors: Karla Mendes (reporter, data analysis, photos and video, and author and project coordinator), Andrés Alegria (data visualization), Daniel Pye (editor), Alex Shaw (fact checker), Ingrid Barros (photos and video), Nanditha Chandraprak (layout), Pulitzer Center’s Rainforest Investigations Network team (Gustavo Faleiros, Keng Kuang, Federico Rainis, Fernanda Buffa)
2025-s-0189.langs: English (I also published a version in Portuguese and Spanish)
2025-s-0189.summaryJa: この調査は,アラリボヤ原住民地域における違法牛牧と伐採の拡大中に,原住民グアジャハラの標的殺戮のパターンを明らかにした.この調査結果は,この地域における数ダースの違法な活動に繋がり,罰を受けない犯罪と関連づけられた. ギャジャジャラ族の4人が殺害され,3人が死亡未遂に生き残った2023年はアラビオアにとって最も致命的な年となった. 1991年から2023年の間に,アラビオアでは38人のギャジャラ族が殺害された.
2025-s-0189.impactJa: 連邦警察,連邦検察官事務所,ブラジル連邦環境機関IBAMAは,調査の結果は前例のないものであり,違法な家畜をアラリボヤから取り除く作戦の鍵となると述べた. 連邦検察官アルフレド・ファルカオは,原住民の指導者パウロ・パウリノ・グアジャラ氏の殺害の法律案を率いる.調査は,違法な森林破壊と原住民の殺害との優れた関連性を明らかにし,パウロの事件を支援するためにそれを利用すると述べた. 2024年12月に,この調査はブラジルで名誉あるメニューを獲得した.また,2月に英国でリリースされた『What Will YOUR Legacy Be?』の引用もされた.この本はAmazonで46位で,すでに再印刷中です. この本は米国とインドでも発売されます.

2025-s-0190.summary: Tráileres, trampa para migrantes” es una investigación colaborativa-transfronteriza que dimensionó por primera vez la magnitud del tráfico de migrantes en tráileres en México. Ante la falta de datos oficiales, la investigación liderada por Noticias Telemundo y CLIP, junto a otros siete medios, creó una base de datos que documentó el viaje de 19,000 migrantes, y al menos 111 muertes entre 2018-2023. El proyecto expuso las condiciones inhumanas de estos viajes y evidenció una relación entre el aumento del uso de camiones y las políticas restrictivas, que dejan a los migrantes sin opciones seguras y benefician a los grupos criminales.

2025-s-0191.summary: A BBC investigation reveals the limited extent of control by the Burmese military junta, which has wielded power in Myanmar since February 2021. An incredibly detailed assessment of more than 14,000 village groups shows the military now has full control of less than a quarter of the country’s landmass. A patchwork of ethnic armies and resistance groups control 42%, while the rest is largely contested. BBC conversations with rebel leaders also uncovered one possible explanation: the military is riddled with double agents loyal to the opposition. These soldier spies are known as ”Watermelons” - green on the outside, rebel red within.
2025-s-0191.impact: The story was produced for multiple platforms including a full-length video documentary, podcast, shorter news packages for the main TV and radio bulletins, social media and online articles in English, Burmese, Thai and other languages. The film on YouTube gained an initial 1.2 million views, with high engagement in Thai, Burmese and Indonesian, and the online article in English was read more than 370,000 times. The story was shared by influential accounts on social media with a strong focus on the data findings which have also been cited in reporting by competitor news organisations.

2025-s-0191.summaryJa: BBCの調査によると,ミャンマーでは2021年2月以来政権を握っているビルマ軍政権が,制限された範囲に及ぶ支配を明らかにしている.14,000以上の村のグループを信じられないほど詳細に評価したところ,米軍は現在,国の土地の四分の一未満を完全に支配していることが明らかになった.民族軍と抵抗集団のパッチワークは42%を支配している.残りの部分は,主に論争されている. BBCの反乱指導者との会話も,一つの可能な説明を発見した:軍勢は反乱に忠実な双方のエージェントで混ざっている.これらの兵士スパイは,水メロン<unk> - 緑の外側,反乱の赤い内側として知られている.

2025-s-0192.summary: This investigative series examines various fisheries crimes that have been perpetrated in eastern Indonesia. These crimes include the enslavement of Indonesian crew members on Russian-flagged vessels, the entry of foreign vessels suspected of illegal fishing, and the involvement of ministers’ children in the fisheries business, which has the potential to cause conflicts of interest. This year-long coverage is a collaboration between Jaring.id and Tempo Magazine, supported by the Pulitzer Center.
2025-s-0192.impact: This coverage series has a readership of hundreds of thousands in Indonesia. In the early days of the administration of President Widodo, the series was also used as advocacy material by KIARA, an Indonesian non-governmental organization (NGO) that focuses on fisheries issues, to highlight the conflict of interest of Sakti Wahyu Trenggono, the Minister of Fisheries appointed by President Widodo.The Earth Justice Foundation (EJF) also used the series as research and advocacy material, especially regarding slavery on Russian-flagged fishing vessels. Following the publication of this series, numerous messages were received from small-scale fishers via social media and email, expressing a continued commitment to advocating for fisheries issues in Indonesia, which government officials have been accused of exploiting for personal gain.
2025-s-0192.tools: Sensor, D3.js, QGIS, Microsoft Excel, Google Sheets, CSV, OpenStreetMap
2025-s-0192.authors: Jaring.id Team:Abdus Somad (Reporter), Damar Fery Ardiyan (Editor), Kholikul Alim (Producer). Tempo Magazine: Yosea Arga (Reporter), Raymundus Rikang (Managing Editor of Investigation Desk). Eka (Web Developer)
2025-s-0192.summaryJa: この調査シリーズは東インドネシアで行われた様々な漁業犯罪を調査しています.これらの犯罪には,インドネシアの乗組員をロシア旗艦船に奴隷にすること,違法漁業を疑う外国船の入侵,そして利益衝突を引き起こす可能性がある漁業ビジネスに部長の子供たちの関与が含まれています. This year-long coverage is a collaboration between Jaring.id and Tempo Magazine, supported by the Pulitzer Center. この年長の報道は,Jaring.idとTempo Magazineの共同制作で,Pulitzer Centerが支援している.
2025-s-0192.impactJa: このコアプレージシリーズはインドネシアで何百万人もの読者を集めていますウォーディドー大統領の政権初期には,このシリーズは漁業問題に焦点を当てたインドネシアのNGOである KIARAによって,大統領 Widodoによって任命された漁業大臣のSakti Wahyu Trenggonoの利益対立を強調するために使用された. このシリーズの出版後,ソーシャルメディアやメールを通じて,小さな漁業者から多数のメッセージが受信され,政府関係者が個人利益のために搾取していると非難されているインドネシアの漁業問題への主張への継続的なコミットメントを表明した.

2025-s-0193.summary: A série Lente de Aumento revelou, de forma inédita, as falhas e desafios no uso de câmeras corporais pela Polícia Militar do Rio de Janeiro. A investigação analisou 774 processos judiciais e expôs crimes, abusos de autoridade, violações de direitos humanos e falta de transparência. Em 61% dos casos, as imagens não foram entregues à Justiça, comprometendo investigações. A série gerou ampla repercussão, mobilizou o Ministério Público a abrir investigações e resultou no afastamento e prisão administrativa de policiais. Com um olhar equilibrado, mostrou tanto os problemas quanto boas práticas, instigando o debate sobre segurança pública e transparência.
2025-s-0193.impact: A série teve um impacto imediato e profundo. Revelou falhas sistêmicas na transparência policial, levando o Ministério Público a abrir 12 investigações e a Polícia Militar a afastar e prender administrativamente 15 policiais envolvidos em irregularidades. A repercussão impulsionou o debate sobre controle externo da atividade policial e o uso de tecnologia para garantir direitos. Além disso, ao humanizar agentes e evidenciar boas práticas, a série contribuiu para uma visão mais equilibrada sobre a segurança pública no Brasil, reforçando o papel do jornalismo investigativo na defesa da democracia e dos direitos fundamentais. Além disso, Lente de Aumento inspirou outros jornalistas a aprofundarem suas investigações sobre o uso da tecnologia na segurança pública. A metodologia utilizada — cruzamento de processos judiciais, análise de dados e investigação de campo — tornou-se referência para novas reportagens sobre controle externo da atividade policial em outros estados. A série também foi citada em seminários acadêmicos e debates sobre jornalismo investigativo e direitos humanos, reforçando seu impacto duradouro.
2025-s-0193.tools: Microsoft Excel, Google Sheets, CSV, Python
2025-s-0193.authors: Guilherme Ramalho, Marcelo Brüzzi, Luiza Guerra, Toni Marques, Daniel Pereira, Willian Correa, José Henrique, Raphael Nascimento.
2025-s-0193.summaryJa: 増加のレントーシリーズでは,リオデジャネイロの軍事警察が体カメラの使用における欠陥と課題を未経験に明らかにしました.調査は774件の訴訟を分析し,犯罪,権力の乱用,人権侵害,透明性の欠如を暴露しました. 捜査を開始させるよう促し,警察官を遠ざけ,行政的に逮捕するに至った. 均衡の見方で,問題と良い慣行の両方を示し,公安と透明性に関する議論を促した.
2025-s-0193.impactJa: 警官による透明性のシステム上の欠陥が明らかになり,検察省が12件の調査を開始し,軍事警察が不正行為に関与した15人の警察官を遠ざけ,行政的に逮捕した. また,捜査官を人間化させ,良い実践を明らかにすることで,このシリーズはブラジルにおける公安に対するより均衡の見方を促し,民主主義と基本権の擁護における調査ジャーナリズムの役割を強化した. 方法論は,司法のプロセス交差,データ分析,フィールド調査を用い,他の州における警察活動の外部制御に関する新たな報道に参考になりました.このシリーズは,研究ジャーナリストと人権に関する学術セミナーや議論でも引用され,持続的な影響を強化しました.

2025-s-0194.summary: This European cross-border investigation provides the first comprehensive analysis of political party funding across all 27 EU member states from 2019-2022. By examining over 1,000 financial reports and 500,000 donations, we uncovered critical transparency gaps: 70% of private donations remain anonymous, totaling €660 million in unaccounted funds. While most parties rely on state subsidies, German parties receive substantial private funding. Additionally, far-right and far-left parties secure 25% of all private funding, demonstrating the financial benefits of political power. This project illuminates crucial democratic accountability issues affecting European political systems.
2025-s-0194.impact: The ”Transparency Gap” investigation exposed the critical lack of transparency in European political funding landscapes, establishing itself as the definitive resource on party financing across the EU. As the first comprehensive cross-border analysis of its kind, the project assembled the most complete dataset on political party funding ever compiled for all 27 EU member states. The investigation generated global attention, with media outlets across continents amplifying its findings. News organizations in South Korea, the United States, Mozambique, and even Russia featured the results, demonstrating the universal relevance of political funding transparency. Transparency-focused NGOs have incorporated the data into their advocacy work, using our findings to strengthen campaigns for stricter disclosure requirements and democratic safeguards. The academic community has expressed strong interest in accessing this valuable dataset for research purposes, recognizing its potential to support empirical studies on political financing and democratic accountability. The database has become a foundational investigative resource, enabling journalists to conduct deeper investigations into specific donors and funding networks. Numerous media organizations have requested access to the data for follow-up reporting and ongoing accountability journalism.
2025-s-0194.tools: Scraping, Google Sheets, CSV, PostgreSQL, Python, metabase

2025-s-0194.summaryJa: この欧州の国境を越えた調査は2019-2022年のEU27加盟国全体における政治党資金の最初の包括的な分析を提供します 1,000以上の財務報告と 500,000の寄付を調査することによって,我々は重要な透明性ギャップを発見しました:70%の民間寄付は匿名であり,合計は66000万ユーロです. さらに,極右派と極左派政党は,すべての民間資金の25%を確保し,政治力の経済的利益を示しています.
2025-s-0194.impactJa: 透明性ギャップ調査は,欧州の政治資金の格差を明らかにし,EU全域における党資金の決定的な資源として確立した. この種の最初の包括的な国境を越えた分析として,このプロジェクトはEU27加盟国すべてにおいて政治政党資金に関する最も完全なデータセットをまとめた. 調査は世界の注目を集め,大陸中のメディアが調査結果を拡大した.韓国,米国,モザンビーク,ロシアなどで報道機関が調査結果を掲載し,政治資金透明性の普遍的な関連性を示した.透明性に焦点を当てたNGOは,我々の調査結果を活用して,より厳しい公開要件や民主的な保障のためのキャンペーンを強化した. 学術コミュニティは,この貴重なデータセットを研究目的のためにアクセスすることに強い関心を示しており,政治資金と民主的な説明責任に関する経験的研究を支援する可能性を認識しています. 多くのメディア組織が追跡報告と継続的な説明責任ジャーナリズムのためにデータにアクセスすることを要求しています

2025-s-0195.summary: The EU Misconduct Investigation is a cross-border research project led by Follow the Money in collaboration with journalists across Europe. It examines integrity scandals involving (candadite) Members of the European Parliament. The investigation reveals widespread misconduct, from corruption and fraud to conflicts of interest and harassment. Findings show that nearly one in four sitting MEPs and one in five leading candidates have been implicated in scandals. By analyzing media reports and political records, the project sheds light on the lack of accountability within EU institutions, highlighting the urgent need for stricter ethics enforcement and transparency reforms.
2025-s-0195.impact: The EU Misconduct Investigation contributed to the debate on political integrity ahead of the 2024 European elections. The first round, which focused on sitting MEPs, led to a follow-up investigation into election candidates, allowing for a broader assessment of political misconduct within the EU. While the project did not spark widespread discussions, it was picked up by various media outlets across different countries, ensuring that the findings reached a relevant audience. Additionally, the team developed a reproducible methodology for investigating political misconduct. This can be used in future research to track integrity issues over time and assess whether reforms in the European Parliament have had any effect. Although the project did not lead to immediate political action, it provided concrete data on corruption, fraud, and ethical violations among EU lawmakers. It offered voters additional information about the candidates and highlighted the need for better transparency and accountability. While the overall impact was limited, the investigation contributed to keeping political integrity on the agenda and laid the groundwork for further scrutiny in the future.
2025-s-0195.tools: Scraping, Google Sheets, CSV, PostgreSQL, Python, Metabase
2025-s-0195.langs: Dutch, French, Bulgarian, German, Estonian, Finnish, Greek, English, Croatian, Polish, Romanian, Slovenian, Slovakian, Spanish, Hungarian, Italian
2025-s-0195.summaryJa: EU Misconduct Investigationは Follow the Moneyがヨーロッパ各地でジャーナリストと協力して主導する国境を越えた研究プロジェクトです. 欧州議会議員候補を巻き込んだ正直なスキャンダルを調査します.調査は腐敗や詐欺から利益紛争や嫌がらせまで,広範な不正行為を明らかにします. 結論は,現役議会議員4人に1人,そしてトップ候補5人に1人がスキャンダルに関与していることを示しています. メディアレポートと政治記録を分析することで,EU機関における説明責任の欠如を明らかにし,より厳しい倫理執行と透明性改革の緊急必要性を強調しています.
2025-s-0195.impactJa: EUの誤った行動調査は2024年の欧州選挙の前での政治整体に関する議論に貢献した.議席議員を中心とした最初のラウンドは,選挙候補に関するフォローアップ調査を導いた.EU内の政治誤った行動のより広範な評価を可能にする.プロジェクトが広範な議論を起こすことはなかったが,さまざまな国のメディアによって拾い上げられ,結果が関連するオーディエンスに達することを確保した. さらに,チームは政治不当を調査するための再現可能な方法論を開発しました. これは将来の研究で,時間とともに正直の問題を追跡し,欧州議会の改革がどのような影響を与えたかを評価するために使用できます.このプロジェクトは,即時政治行動につながらなかったが,EU立法者間で腐敗,詐欺,倫理違反に関する具体的なデータを提供しました. 選挙人に関する追加情報を提供し,より透明性と説明責任の必要性を強調した. 全体的な影響は限られたが,調査は政治の整体性を議題に保つのに貢献し,将来さらなる審査の基礎を設けた.

2025-s-0196.summary: Together with eight regional media, we analyzed freely available satellite imagery to map the extent of glyphosate use in Dutch agriculture. We identified some 14 thousand fields (over 42 thousand hectares) where farmers used glyphosate in the early spring to make them cultivable. This could be done by detecting the distinct yellowing of these fields in the early spring. We used this data to calculate the proximity of these fields to schools, protected nature reserves, and drinking water protection zones. We revealed that 700,000 Dutch people live within 250 meters of such fields.
2025-s-0196.impact: The method we developed for this article produced novel results, which garnered a lot of attention. The article was the best-read article of the year at FTM and the results were published in 7 other regional media, and the main findings were published by the NOS(Dutch public broadcasting company) as well. The analysis gives valuable insights into the far-reaching consequences of the effects of widespread pesticide use in a country as densely populated as the Netherlands. Our article contributed to an ongoing (political) discussion on restricting pesticide use, and as a response, parliamentary questions were also asked. The ability to detect pesticide-use with the help of remote sensing (RS) techniques had never been done before. Therefore, we are also cooperating with the Wageningen University and Research to publish a scientific paper to present our results alongside those from a similar research project.
2025-s-0196.authors: Jan Daalder, Collin van Rooij (Follow the Money) Full list of partners available upon request.
2025-s-0196.summaryJa: 地域メディア8社と協力して衛星画像を分析しオランダの農業におけるグリフォサートの利用の規模を地図化しました農民が早期にグリフォサートを栽培できる農場として利用した14000の畑を特定しましたこのデータを利用してこれらの田舎の近隣を学校や保護された自然保護区や飲料水保護区に計算しましたそして,7億人のオランダ人が 250メートル以内に住んでいるとわかりました
2025-s-0196.impactJa: この記事のために開発した方法は,注目を集めた新鮮な結果をもたらしましたこの記事はFTMで年度で最もよく読まれた記事であり,結果は他の7つの地域メディアで公開され,主な発見は NOS (オランダの公共放送会社) によりも公開されました. この分析は,オランダのような人口密集した国で広範囲にわたる農薬の使用の影響の深遠な影響への貴重な洞察を与えてくれます. 農薬の使用を制限する議論を継続し,議会の質問も提出されました農薬の使用を遠隔感知技術 (RS) で検出する能力はこれまで一度も実現されていなかったので,我々は同様の研究プロジェクトで得た成果とともに科学論文を発表するために,ワゲンゲンゲン大学と研究と協力しています.

2025-s-0197.summary: Are you rich? is a sophisticated exploration of different measures of personal wealth - capturing thousands of data points in an innovative and repeatable new format that builds complex data stories that are completely tailored to each reader. We used this project as an opportunity to reimagine how we could present deep-dive data stories, to help even our most data-averse readers find value and insight into their own lives.
2025-s-0197.impact: Since publication, Are you rich? has hurtled to the top of the newsroom’s leaderboards for article engagement and subscriptions. On those measures it’s the best performing piece of content since our current metrics system was introduced in 2021. It’s an unprecedented acquisition driver across every single one of our platforms, including homepage, app, social and newsletters. Its success on paid social is one the primary reasons for the business’s focused investment in the channel in 2024. What’s more, we’ve also seen a pattern of low subscriber churn on our money tools, suggesting readers truly value being taken ‘under the bonnet’ of a data story to help them understand their own finances. Our tool has been cited by Forbes as one of just two tools in the market to “help you calculate where you sit concerning British society” - the other being the ONS. Are you rich? highlights inequalities in society and speaks to a natural curiosity about wealth and how much you earn - a topic that people (especially the British!) don’t typically talk about in real life.
2025-s-0197.tools: Animation, Personalisation, Json, Google Sheets, CSV, Python, Node.js, React.js
2025-s-0197.authors: Mariana Hallal, Sophie Robin, Olga Petrusewicz, Anthony Mason, George Ioakeimidis, Florin Bratescu, David Green, Elliot Tawney, Rachel Jones, Oliver Edgington
2025-s-0197.summaryJa: あなたは金持ちですか?とは,個人富の異なる測定法を洗練された探求で,何千ものデータポイントを革新的で繰り返される新しい形式で捉え,それぞれの読者に完全に合わせた複雑なデータストーリーを構築しています. 私たちはこのプロジェクトを利用して,より深いデータストーリーをどのように提示できるかを再考する機会として利用しました.
2025-s-0197.impactJa: 記事への関与とサブスクリプションに関するニュースルームのランキングトップに急上昇した『Are You Rich?』は,この指標で2021年に現在のメトリックシステムが導入されて以来,最も優れたコンテンツです.ホームページ,アプリ,ソーシャル・サイト,ニュースレターなど,すべてのプラットフォームで前例のない買収ドライバーです. 収入のあるソーシャルで成功することは,2024年に事業がチャンネルへの集中的な投資を促す主な理由の一つである. さらに,私たちは私たちのお金ツールでサブスクリプションの低迷のパターンを目撃しており,読者は自分の財務を理解するのに役立つデータストーリーの帽子の下に置かれていることを本当に重視していることを示唆しています. フォブス誌は,英国社会に関する自分の立場を計算するのに役立つ2つのツールのうちの"つとして,このツールを引用しています.もう一つはONSです.あなたは裕福ですか? 社会における不平等を強調し,富や収入について自然に好奇心を惹きつけます.

2025-s-0198.summary: This investigation was conducted using open-source intelligence techniques, using subject access requests to retrieve my personal data from Meta and a combination of R Studio and Excel to analyse almost 20,000 HTML files, containing every interaction with Facebook, Instagram and third-party sites where Meta had tracked me. Investigating the opaque data harvesting practices of technology companies is near impossible – so I used my personal data as a microcosm to shed light on these secretive practices.
2025-s-0198.impact: The article has now been read by 80,000 people, who stayed on the page for almost five minutes on average. It also led to coverage on the BBC, amongst other outlets, and will be central to an upcoming TV documentary. I was also invited to talk about the work at a technology conference in Vilnius, for tech start-ups and other journalists to learn from my techniques and story. Fifteen local councils, several health charities and two NHS Trusts ceased their usage of Meta pixels to track users after seeing the results of this investigation. The Information Commissioner’s Office is also considering further action against health and education companies still using the technology, uncovered by my reporting. Additionally, I worked with The Times’s podcast team to create an episode of ‘The Story’ that could be embedded within the article, to give readers further insight into such a complex topic. It became one of The Times’ most popular podcast episodes at the time.
2025-s-0198.tools: Scraping, Adobe Creative Suite, Microsoft Excel, Google Sheets, CSV, R, RStudio
2025-s-0198.summaryJa: この調査はオープンソースの情報技術を使って行われたもので,対象者のアクセス要求を使用してメタから私の個人データを取得し,R StudioとExcelの組み合わせを使って, ほぼ20,000のHTMLファイルを分析し, メタが追跡したFacebook,Instagram,第三者のサイトとのあらゆる相互作用を含めた. テクノロジー企業の不透明なデータ収集の慣行を調査することはほぼ不可能ですだから私は個人データを微小宇宙として使ってこれらの秘密の慣行を明らかにしました
2025-s-0198.impactJa: この記事は現在8万人の読者によって読み上げられ,平均で5分近くページに留まりました.またBBCの報道にもつながり,他のメディアにもつながり,そして,即日放送されるテレビドキュメンタリーにも中心となるでしょう.また,ヴィルニウスで技術会議で技術スタートアップや他のジャーナリストが私の技術や物語から学ぶために,作業について話すよう招待されました. 15の地方議会やいくつかの保健慈善団体と NHS トラストはこの調査の結果を目撃した後にメタピクセルをユーザを追跡するために使用することを停止しました情報委員会事務局は,私の報告で明らかになったように,まだこの技術を利用している医療および教育企業に対するさらなる措置を検討しています. 記事に組み込まれる"The Story"のエピソードを作成するために,タイムズ・ポッドキャストチームと協力し,読者にこのような複雑なトピックの詳細な洞察を与えました.

2025-s-0199.summary: InSight Crime’s 2023 Cocaine Seizure Round-Up analyzes the international cocaine trade from seed to seller. Based on our daily news monitoring, official statistics, and data obtained via public information requests, we identified and analyzed the cocaine trafficking trends in production, transit, and consumer countries for 2023. We combined the data with our extensive fieldwork to better understand the cocaine trade dynamics in the world. We published this special in both, Enlish and Spanish, and as a PDF.
2025-s-0199.impact: InSight Crime’s 2023 Cocaine Seizure Round-Up got 48,755 and generated 1,961downloads, a clear indicator that users found the content engaging. Media outlets from Trinidad and Tobago, Honduras, the United States, Paraguay, Colombia, Dominican Republic, Spain, Peru, Mexico and Ecuador cited our special. Also, the GJIN included our Round-Up in the Data Journalism Top 10.
2025-s-0199.tools: Scraping, D3.js, QGIS, Json, Adobe Creative Suite, Microsoft Excel, Google Sheets, CSV, R, RStudio, Python
2025-s-0199.summaryJa: InSight Crime<unk>s 2023 Cocaine Seizure Round-Upは,国際コカイン貿易を種から売り手まで分析しています. 私たちの日常ニュースモニタリング,公式統計,および公の情報要求を通じて取得されたデータに基づいて,我々は,2023年の生産,輸送,消費国のコカイン取引の傾向を特定し,分析しました. この特集は英語とスペイン語の両方で PDFとして公開されました
2025-s-0199.impactJa: InSight Crime<unk>s 2023 Cocaine Seizure Round-Upは48,755件を記録し,1961件をダウンロードした. ユーザーたちがコンテンツを魅力的に発見した明確な指標である. トリニダード・トバゴ,ホンジュラス,アメリカ,パラグアイ,コロンビア,ドミニカ共和国,スペイン,ペルー,メキシコ,エクアドルからのメディア・オウトレーットは,私たちの特集を引用した. また,GJINはデータジャーナリズムトップ10に私たちの Round-Upを含めた.

2025-s-0200.summary: For six months, our project investigated the fare system of Grab, the most popular ride-hailing app in the Philippines, used by millions of Filipinos. The company advertises that the price for their rides depends on supply and demand, but the way its algorithm calculates these fares is opaque. Our investigation revealed that customers always pay a so-called surge fee, regardless of booking time and location, which can double the cost of a ride. We also found that higher fees didn’t necessarily mean shorter wait times, which was one of the objectives of surge pricing in the first place.
2025-s-0200.impact: Our investigation, the first of its kind in the Philippines, exposed how technological innovations like ride-hailing apps are supposed to improve people’s lives, but because their advancement has far outpaced existing laws, benefits tend to be unevenly distributed, with the companies often having undue advantage. The reports were widely received and sparked public discourse on the use of these widely popular apps. It was PCIJ’s top story of the year. The podcast, aired by PumaPodcast, also gained significant plays. The coverage also triggered more reporting on platform services using the accountability lens. Reporting went beyond PR-driven or earnings stories. In December 2024, Philippine Senator Raffy Tulfo led a probe on surge fees imposed by the Transportation Network Vehicle Services in the country, including Grab Philippines. The lawmaker also sought to investigate the senior citizen and persons with disability discounts that app companies pass onto workers when it should be the companies carrying these costs. This prompted the Land Transportation Franchising and Regulatory Board to look into the matter. Seven months after the publication of the stories, at least two more apps, InDrive and Lala Ride, were launched. Although Grab still dominates the market, customers are able to explore other options.
2025-s-0200.tools: AI/Machine learning, Scraping, Json, Google Sheets, CSV, Python, * Rotative VPNs (ProtonVPN, + Tunnelblick + tunblkctl) * Google Maps * Statistical analysis

The stories were published by the Philippine Center for Investigative Journalism (PCIJ), PumaPodcast, and Commoner. == Karol Ilagan, Federico Acosta Rainis, Jabes Florian Lazaro, Felipe Salvosa II, Bernard Testa, Angelica Alcantara, Jay-ar Alombro, Donna Clarisse Blacer, Lyjah Tiffany Bonzo, James Kenneth Calzado, Gina de Castro, Maverick de Castro, Dominique Flores, Lois Garcia, Guinevere Latoza, Aya Mance, Faith Maniquis, Karmela Melgarejo, Gabriel Muñoz, Arone Jervin Ocampo, Matthew Raralio, Arriana Santos, and Angelica Ty (PCIJ - https://pcij.org/2024/07/12/grab-fares-surge-under-opaque-algorithm/) Karol Ilagan, Federico Acosta Rainis, Carljoe Javier, Felipe Salvosa II, Pidoy Blanco, and Jil Caro (PumaPodcast - https://open.spotify.com/episode/3Q0Tc0mglHYyRjLViKIRY6) JP Campos, Ariane Arbolado, Ramon Castañeda, Miggie Bacungan, Marky Saavedra, Jana Codera, Albert Saspa , Dani Patalinghog, Karol Ilagan, and Federico Acosta Rainis (Commoner - https://www.instagram.com/p/C9hQjugv7pj/?hl=en&img_index=1)
2025-s-0200.summaryJa: フィリピンでは数百万人の人が利用しているGrabの料金システムについて調査した.このプロジェクトは6ヶ月間続いた. フィリピンの数百万人の人々が利用しているGrabの料金システムについて調査した.この会社は,彼らの料金価格が供給と需要に依存すると宣伝している.しかし,アルゴリズムはこれらの料金計算の方法は不透明である.私たちの調査は,顧客が予約時間や場所に関係なく常にいわゆる高額料金を払うことが明らかになった. また,高い料金が必ずしも待機時間が短くなることを意味するものではないことがわかりました.
2025-s-0200.impactJa: フィリピンで初めて行われた調査では,ライドヘイリングアプリのような技術革新が人々の生活を改善するはずの方法が明らかになったが,その進歩が既存の法律をはるかに上回っているため,利益は不均等に分配され,企業はしばしば過当な利点を得ている.このレポートは広く受け取り,これらの広く人気のあるアプリの使用に関する公論を引き起こす.これはPCIJの年度トップニュースでした. PumaPodcastが放送したポッドキャストも大きな声を出した.報道は,説明責任レンズを用いたプラットフォームサービスに関する報告を増やした.報道はPRを駆動したまたは収益の物語を超えた.2024年12月にフィリピン上院議員ラフィー・トゥルフォは,Grab Philippinesを含む国内における交通ネットワーク車両サービスによって課された高額料金に関する調査を主導した. 法律家は,高齢者および障害者による割引を調査し,アプリ会社はこれらの費用を担う企業であるべきであれば,従業員に渡すようにしました.これは陸上交通法人および規制委員会にこの問題を調査するよう促しました.物語が公表されて7ヶ月後,少なくとも2つのアプリ,インドライブとララライドが開始されました. 市場をまだGrabが支配しているものの,顧客は他のオプションを探索することができます.

2025-s-0201.summary: Using grains of sand to represent individual votes, The Washington Post created a three-dimensional mapping project that unpacks the 2024 U.S. presidential election. The aim of this data visualization was to not only present the numbers but also depict America in a more realistic and nuanced way — showing a nation that is much more purple and interconnected than the typical red-and-blue maps suggest.
2025-s-0201.impact: The challenge was to create an innovative representation of the 2024 presidential election results that went beyond traditional approaches. The aim was to not only present the numbers but also depict America in a more realistic and nuanced way—showing a nation that is much more purple and interconnected than the typical red-and-blue maps suggest. Experts in the field such as Andy Kirk or Kenneth Field said about this project: “One of the best visual concepts I’ve seen all year. (…) Just brilliant.” and “I really enjoy creative ways to map data that’s been mapped a thousand times before. It’s hard to do something new. This acts like a dasymetric dot density map but with a twist by building up in the third dimension”
2025-s-0201.tools: Animation, 3D modeling, AI/Machine learning, D3.js, QGIS, Canvas, Json, Adobe Creative Suite, Microsoft Excel, Google Sheets, CSV, R, Python, Node.js, Blender, Obersvable

(...) 素晴らしく.<unk> そして,私は以前から千回以上映射されたデータを地図化する創造的な方法が大好きです.新しいことをすることは難しい.これはダシメトリックな点密度地図のように機能しますが,第三次元で構築することで歪みがあります<unk>

2025-s-0202.summary: يوثق التحقيق وقوع بعض أطباء التخدير والعناية المركزة والطوارئ في مصر في فخ إدمان العقاقير الطبية، إذا تحايل هؤلاء على بروتوكول صرف المسكنات الأفيونية عبر طرق متنوعة. وثقت من خلال تحقيقات النيابة وشهادة المديرين المباشرين للمتعاطين وزملائهم وذوي الأطباء أنفسهم كشف إدمان 13 طبيبا/ ة منهم 2 من أقسام خارج الطوارئ والعناية المركزة والتخدير غالبيتهم فصلوا من أماكن عملهم، عدد منهم أثبتت تحقيقات النيابة العامة والمباحث وفاتهم وإلى جوارهم حقن عقاقير خاصة بالمرضى تعاطوها قبل الوفاة مباشرة وهم من لم يتم كشف إدمانهم إلا بعد وفاتهم.
2025-s-0202.impact: لقى التحقيق ردود فعل واسعة بعد نشره على منصات التواصل الاجتماعي ،أعلن مدير صندوق مكافحة الإدمان في نوفمبر 2024 بعد نشر التحقيق إجراء الكشف عن المخدرات لجميع موظفي الدولة في أماكن عملهم وستكون سلبية النتيجة شرطا أساسيا للترقية أو الاستمرار في العمل.
